data.value: REST API for air quality monitoring

data.name: RegisterDescription
data.value:
Creates a new user.
If user already exists: - validates password - returns existing API token
Example request:
POST /api/auth/register
{ "email": "user@gmail.com", "password": "StrongPassword123" }

MeasurementGetDescription
data.value:
Returns the latest measurements from all users. Each object contains pollutant data (co, no2, pm25, pm10, coordinates, and timestamp).
No authentication required.
Example response:
[ { "co": 0.4, "no2": 0.02, "pm25": 12.5, "pm10": 25.0, "latitude": 55.751244, "longitude": 37.618423, "timestamp": "2025-01-27T11:30:00Z" } ]
